title: Frogs of the Pampas
instructions: Circle the single correct answer for each question.

questions.text: Which frog is endemic to the Wetlands of San Fernando?
questions.explanation: Pleurodema thaul is the only one native to the Wetlands of San Fernando.

questions.text: What do tadpoles breathe with before they grow lungs?
questions.explanation: Tadpoles use external gills and permeable skin until metamorphosis.
